## Lesson 3 — Declare the authoring diagram {#lesson-ch7-diagrams}

Current source cells use full explicit layouts bound to fresh preparation. Stored figures and Notebook outputs retain their original execution identities; this source-only update does not regenerate them.

### Review the declared body

```{python}
#| id: ch7-render-authoring
from examples.engineer.diagram_layouts import engineer_layout

authoring_preparation = plan.prepare_schematic(
    CircuitDiagramSpec(
        theme=Theme.AUTO,
        show_parameter_values=True,
    )
)
authoring_layout = engineer_layout(authoring_preparation, "ordered_mtl")
authoring = plan.render_schematic(
    CircuitDiagramSpec(
        layout=authoring_layout, theme=Theme.AUTO,
        show_parameter_values=True,
    )
)
display(authoring.show())
```
